proof_body:
by
  intro a n hn
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(h n hn).2 le_rfl, ?_⟩
    by_contra hc
    have hc' : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < a := by
      push_cast
      exact not_le.1 hc
    have := (h (n + 1) (by omega)).1 hc'
    omega
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ k _
    constructor
    · intro hk
      have h3 : (k : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
      have h4 : k < n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h3
      omega
    · intro hk
      have h3 : (k : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hk
      linarith
